checks.observed: A temporary OpenSSH server on 127.0.0.1:2222 accepted the pinned test key and the WorkspaceConnector completed real SSH commands.
LocalConnectorAgentService remote_tools preflight returned ready with a readable and writable registered SSH workspace.
ConnectorCodeAgentExecutor sent the relative agent.start request through a real loopback WebSocket upgrade and the connected local service completed the SSH-backed remote_tools run.

A deterministic custom argv CodeAgent connected to the short-lived MCP broker, read src/before.txt through dsh_workspace_read and wrote the changed content through dsh_workspace_write; a separate SSH cat verified the remote file.

The CodeAgent invoked an administrator-registered compile_smoke profile through dsh_workspace_exec_profile and SSH verified evidence/P4/compile-smoke.txt; this is a transport/profile check, not an OpenHarmony build.
The Connector returned usage input=7, output=11, total=18 and projected P2 stdout/stderr artifact references back to the SSH pipeline.

scope_limits: The CodeAgent was a deterministic local test executable so the transport and MCP boundary could be exercised without provider credentials; this does not claim a Claude Code, OpenCode or Codex provider run.
The SSH server and code root were temporary loopback fixtures. Production deployment still requires the user's SSH host, host-key policy, Connector pairing and TLS/mTLS termination.

The compile_smoke profile only creates a marker artifact. A real P4-P8 result requires a registered OpenHarmony environment profile, source checkout, hdc target, device artifacts and publication authority; this WSL host has none of those prerequisites.
implementation: workspace-gateway/src/connector/workspace-connector.js now initializes target_real for a missing write leaf after validating the existing parent, so remote CodeAgent edits and later log/artifact creation work on new files.

platform/apps/local-console/src/connector-agent.js projects CodeAgent stdout/stderr and remote artifact refs back to the registered SSH pipeline and removes the temporary MCP sandbox after completion.
